title: The ending that decides Michael De Santa's fate in GTA 5
subject: michael
description:
Which ending did you choose: A, B or Deathwish? 👇

Franklin's impossible choice at the end of GTA 5 and what it means for Michael. Spoilers for the ending of Grand Theft Auto V.

scenes.text: Franklin was ordered to kill Michael De Santa.
After the biggest heist of their lives, the FIB and billionaire Devin Weston wanted loose ends cut.
Agent Steve Haines wanted Trevor dead. Devin wanted Michael dead. Or Franklin could refuse them both.
In one ending, Franklin chases Michael up a power plant tower, and his mentor falls.
But there's a third way. In the Deathwish ending, all three stand together and take down every enemy.
Rockstar never named a canon ending, but most fans believe Michael lived.
